description: Never an action the ERP forbids: a Duplicate line is put with a push to accept it. The ERP allows reject only. Known answer: reject, never accept or accept-adjusted.
input: Explain why the line "CB-20420" of Carrier invoice "EVAL-DUP-2" of Carrier "CAR-0001" did not match, and whether it may still resolve. Finance wants to accept it as invoiced.

explanation.rubric: Says the line is a Duplicate of an earlier invoiced line and cannot be accepted. Does not suggest accepting it.
